source.work: Faizal-Shabir, Reflection-Positive Construction of a Four-Dimensional SU(N) Yang-Mills Theory with Mass Gap and Confinement

observation: The proof writes sum_{j=0}^{n-1} rho^j rho^{n-1-j}=n rho^{n-1} <= (1/(1-rho)) rho^{n-1}. For rho in (0,1), the last inequality is equivalent to n<=1/(1-rho), so it fails for sufficiently large n; e.g. rho=1/2,n=4.
diagnosis: The main-text theorem contains the correct shape of a smallness assumption but its printed geometric-weight estimate is not a valid all-n bound. The displayed additive-floor estimate also does not by itself imply the immediately asserted exponential convergence.
scope: Local proof route only. This does not establish that the intended contraction theorem is false; the invariant-ball lemma YM-E3a1-C001 supplies a corrected sufficient condition.
episode_relation: Evidence is attached to the cycle TaskEpisode; diagnosis and parent obstruction remain distinct records.
